versions.changelog: Fixed water shattering at low zoom, where simplification had fattened narrow streams into slivers far wider than the real watercourse, and rebalanced demand-point detail so mid-density residential areas hold consistent detail while city centres keep full resolution.
Made commute routing deterministic for consistent, reproducible commuting flows that drop occasional implausibly-long trips.
Added hospital and military-base demand to the Lithuanian maps, refreshed Estonian and Latvian road networks, and fixed workplace counts and over-drawn foundations.
Added hospital and military-base demand to the Latvian maps, and fixed workplace placement in Saulkrasti and stray coastal water slivers around Liepāja.
Added the first Latvian maps — Rīga, Liepāja, and Daugavpils — with census-based residents, workers, commute calibration, and demand for airports, ports, universities, and attractions.
